def_en: to take further action on something
note_ru: Рабочая классика: follow up on the email — напомнить о письме. Follow-up — «созвон по итогам».
example: I'll follow up on this next week.
example_ru: Я вернусь к этому вопросу на следующей неделе.

examples_extra.en: Did anyone follow up with the client?
examples_extra.ru: Кто-нибудь связался с клиентом по итогам?

examples_extra.en: Follow up your interview with a short email.

def_en: to reduce the number of options
note_ru: Narrow down the list to three — сузить список до трёх.
example: We narrowed the choice down to two flats.
example_ru: Мы сузили выбор до двух квартир.

examples_extra.en: Can you narrow down the dates?
The police narrowed down the suspects.

def_en: to remove small problems
note_ru: «Разгладить утюгом» шероховатости: iron out the details.
example: We still need to iron out a few details.
example_ru: Нам ещё нужно утрясти пару деталей.

examples_extra.en: They ironed out their differences.
The bugs were ironed out before launch.

def_en: to choose one person or thing from a group
note_ru: И в хорошем, и в плохом: singled out for praise / for criticism.
example: The coach singled her out for praise.

examples_extra.en: Why single me out? Everyone was late.
The report singles out two problems.

def_en: to choose not to take part
note_ru: Opt out of the newsletter — отписаться. Противоположность — opt in.
example: You can opt out at any time.
example_ru: Вы можете отказаться в любой момент.

examples_extra.en: Half the team opted out of the trip.
I opted out of the extra insurance.

def_en: to include something when calculating
note_ru: Factor in the taxes — заложи налоги в расчёт.
example: Don't forget to factor in delivery costs.

examples_extra.en: We factored in a week for testing.
Factor in the jet lag when you plan.

def_en: to add details to an idea
note_ru: «Нарастить мясо» на скелет идеи: flesh out the proposal.
example: Let's flesh out the plan before the pitch.

examples_extra.en: The writer fleshed out the minor characters.
These notes need fleshing out.

def_en: to launch something for many users
note_ru: Айтишная классика: roll out the update gradually — выкатывать обновление постепенно.
example: The feature rolls out next month.

examples_extra.en: They rolled out the new menu in ten cities.
examples_extra.ru: Новое меню запустили в десяти городах.

examples_extra.en: The update was rolled out overnight.

def_en: to explain something very clearly and directly
note_ru: Do I have to spell it out? — «мне что, по буквам объяснить?».
example: The contract spells out every duty.
example_ru: В контракте прямо прописана каждая обязанность.

examples_extra.en: Let me spell out what this means for us.
examples_extra.ru: Позвольте прямо объяснить, что это для нас значит.

examples_extra.en: He spelled out the risks one by one.
examples_extra.ru: Он по пунктам разжевал все риски.

def_en: to consider all parts of a plan carefully
note_ru: Think it through — обдумай как следует, со всеми последствиями.
example: Think it through before you resign.
example_ru: Продумай всё как следует, прежде чем увольняться.

examples_extra.en: The plan wasn't thought through.
examples_extra.ru: План не был продуман до конца.

examples_extra.en: Give me a day to think things through.

def_en: to tell someone an idea to get their opinion
note_ru: Run it by the boss — покажи это боссу. Run that by me again — повтори-ка ещё раз.
example: Let me run this idea by you.
example_ru: Дай я обкатаю эту идею на тебе.

examples_extra.en: Run the text by legal first.
Can you run that by me again?

def_en: to formally approve; to end a broadcast or letter
note_ru: Sign off on the design — дать финальное добро. В письмах: время прощаться — I'll sign off here.
example: The director signed off on the budget.

examples_extra.en: We can't print until they sign off.
examples_extra.ru: Мы не можем печатать, пока они не утвердят.

examples_extra.en: Time to sign off - see you tomorrow.

def_en: to gradually reduce activity; to relax
note_ru: Wind произносится «уайнд». Wind down after work — выдохнуть после работы.
example: I need an hour to wind down after work.
example_ru: Мне нужен час, чтобы выдохнуть после работы.

examples_extra.en: The company is winding down the project.
Music helps me wind down.

def_en: to finish something; to dress warmly
note_ru: Let's wrap up — «давайте закругляться». Wrap up warm — оденься теплее!
example: Let's wrap up the meeting.

examples_extra.en: We wrapped up the project on Friday.
Wrap up warm, it's freezing out.

def_en: to mention a subject briefly
note_ru: The talk touched on privacy — доклад коснулся приватности. Кратко, без погружения.
example: We only touched on the pricing question.
example_ru: Вопрос цены мы затронули лишь вскользь.

examples_extra.en: The article touches on three themes.
He touched on his childhood in the interview.
examples_extra.ru: В интервью он коснулся своего детства.

def_en: to compare advantages and disadvantages
note_ru: Weigh up the pros and cons — взвесить за и против.
example: We're weighing up both offers.

examples_extra.en: Weigh up the risks before you invest.
She weighed up her options carefully.

def_en: to suggest an idea or person for consideration
note_ru: Put forward a proposal — внести предложение. Формальнее, чем suggest.
example: She put forward a bold proposal.

examples_extra.en: His name was put forward for the award.
Two plans were put forward at the meeting.

def_en: to resist a plan; to delay something
note_ru: Два офисных смысла: the team pushed back on the idea и push back the meeting to 4pm.
example: The team pushed back on the new schedule.

examples_extra.en: Can we push the call back an hour?
examples_extra.ru: Можем сдвинуть созвон на час позже?

examples_extra.en: Expect some pushback from the clients.

def_en: to leave an important job or position
note_ru: Мягче, чем resign: step down as chairman — покинуть пост председателя.
example: The CEO stepped down after eight years.
example_ru: Гендиректор покинул пост после восьми лет.

examples_extra.en: She stepped down for family reasons.
examples_extra.ru: Она ушла с поста по семейным обстоятельствам.

examples_extra.en: Calls for him to step down grew louder.
examples_extra.ru: Призывы к его отставке становились громче.

def_en: to take control of something
note_ru: Take over the family business — принять семейное дело. Takeover — поглощение компании.
example: She took over the project in May.

examples_extra.en: A bigger firm took over our company.
Can you take over while I'm away?

def_en: to give something to someone else
note_ru: Hand over the keys — передать ключи. Передача дел — handover.
example: He handed over the keys to the new owner.

examples_extra.en: I'm handing over my projects this week.
examples_extra.ru: На этой неделе я передаю свои проекты.

examples_extra.en: The thief was handed over to the police.

def_en: to stop demanding something after opposition
note_ru: Neither side backed down — ни одна сторона не уступила. Про споры и требования.
example: He refused to back down.

examples_extra.en: The company backed down after the protests.
She never backs down in an argument.
examples_extra.ru: В споре она никогда не отступает.

def_en: to develop or end in a particular way
note_ru: Let's see how it pans out — посмотрим, как всё сложится. Из золотоискательства!
example: The plan didn't pan out.

examples_extra.en: Let's see how the trial week pans out.
Things panned out better than expected.

def_en: to fail to happen
note_ru: The deal fell through — сделка сорвалась. Про планы, продажи, договорённости.
example: Our holiday plans fell through.

examples_extra.en: The sale fell through at the last minute.
If this falls through, we have a plan B.
examples_extra.ru: Если это сорвётся, у нас есть план Б.

def_en: to continue for too long
note_ru: The meeting dragged on — собрание тянулось бесконечно. С оттенком скуки.
example: The talks dragged on for months.

examples_extra.en: The film dragged on and on.
Don't let the case drag on.

def_en: to admire and respect someone
note_ru: Смотреть «снизу вверх» с уважением. Противоположность — look down on (смотреть свысока).
example: Kids look up to their coaches.

examples_extra.en: I've always looked up to my grandmother.
Don't look down on beginners.
